name: OpenSCAD
role: Script-only solid modeller (CSG) with a headless CLI for STL, 3MF, SVG and PNG export
summary: OpenSCAD turns a text .scad script into a solid. Variables are overridden per run with -D, and one run exports STL, 3MF, SVG (2D projection) or a PNG preview with a set camera and size. Geometry is a pure function of the script and its variables. The CLI sits on PATH when installed from the snapshot cask.
use_when: Existing .scad models or libraries such as BOSL2 must become STL, SVG or a still
A parametric part is wanted as text with command-line overrides and no Python or Node
A quick preview PNG with a fixed camera is enough, with no Blender step
avoid_when: Fillets, STEP or exact B-rep work: build123d
Booleans on triangle meshes in Node or a browser: manifold
Lighting, materials or final frames: Blender or Three.js
Byte-identical 3MF output is required: it embeds a timestamp and random UUIDs
license: GPL-2.0 with a linking exception (COPYING); GitHub reports NOASSERTION. Models and libraries carry their own licences.
notes: 2026-11-27: lead said the stable cask is 2021.01 and the snapshot 2026.10.11; the snapshot ran as 2026.10.11 and puts openscad on PATH (the lead said the CLI sits inside an app bundle). Manifold is the default backend, CGAL is selectable with --backend.
2026-11-27: help text lists --animate N for $t frames; not exercised. Only the CLI was run, never the GUI.

assessment.rationale: GPL-2.0 with exception, active (push 2026-11-23). Adds the text-CAD language and its large .scad corpus beside build123d (Python B-rep) and manifold (mesh library); headless export ran on macOS without a GUI.

evidence.result: Block 40x30x10 and -D override 50x20x8: Manifold STL watertight, volume within 1e-9 of analytic (11214.917211, 6768.990186), 528 faces; CGAL STL watertight, volume off by 3.4e-9 (KNOWN FAIL at 1e-9). STL byte-identical across runs. 3MF differs (CreationDate, UUIDs): KNOWN FAIL. SVG viewBox 42x32, 2 contours. PNG 400x300 byte-identical twice, inspected.
evidence.scope: Fixture-reported, macOS arm64 snapshot 2026.10.11: -D overrides to STL, SVG, fixed-camera PNG; 3MF not deterministic and CGAL 3e-9 volume gap fail; no --animate, GUI, libraries.
